[b][i]Vyre News International Radio  2028/7/3[/i][/b]

Calieno-Ruiz, The Liberal Parliamentary Party, The Nations Leading Murderers! Signs and billboards like this line Lamandican highways for all to see, as election season has begun in Lamandica. It would take every right-leaning politician in Lamandica to disappear for any shot of the Parliament Liberals to win, but even then Im not sure says Ribrauta Poapetry, a worker in one of Lamandicas Southern Tier textile mills. Hes done nothing to win independents over; hes given no cause for the right-leaning to flip. Hes instead funded personal pet projects in Mandalay Bay and Horgingtonia. Look how that turned out.

The Parliamentary Liberal Party, the current majority in parliament and the party of Prime Minister Juan Sorobzaul Calieno-Ruiz has polled catastrophically over the past few months, and there is nothing they can do to stop the bleeding. Nearly every projection and poll has shown the opposition, led by Quitford F. Boxeton of the Labour-Conservatives. He represents us better," says longtime voter Reginaldo Mul-Jett. Many say Boxeton has a more firm hand. He would never force an army to the border of our most powerful neighbor, then immediately backtrack. He wouldnt colonize part of a different continent and form an oil colony when other nations were offering trades with us.

Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz knows his days are numbered as his opponents gain favorability. Calieno-Ruiz made a statement informing that the last few months of his partys parliamentary majority and the last year and a half of his tenure will focus on domestic issues aligning with the views of his party and the people of Lamandica. In the autumn, Lamandican citizens will vote in elections to determine the seats of parliament for the parliamentary district they live in for the next two years in the autumn. These elected representatives will then make their decision on the new prime minister a year later. Mul-Jett closes, I urge that we Lamandicans support our Labour-Conservatives this election and put the right guy, our guy, in charge. Vivalova Lamandica!

[i]From the Alosburg Communications Tower in Taultion, this is Vyre International News. [/i]
